sections.changelog: v1.2.107: Finishes the Studio polish pass after v1.2.106. CSS Studio now keeps its editor sidecar placement instead of being flattened by the generic standalone panel rule. Media Studio collections now have an MV-styled right-click menu, local collection rename/remove actions, sub-collection creation, drag-to-reorder, and Shift-drop nesting. The release keeps the short mv-wp package filename while preserving the internal variable-engine WordPress plugin folder.
